title: Explosive Deaths!
description: Players EXPLODE upon death. What else is there to say?
body:
This datapack makes it so whenever a player dies a primed TNT with instant fuse time spawns on their location of destruction. This can be really fun for custom PVP scenarios with your friends as it fundamentally changes the gameplay. If any bugs occur feel free to report them in the corresponding page.

-**NOTE:** you will LOSE all your items.
